title: WPT model recipe (data/recipes/models/<name>.json): everything that changes the resulting model

data.description: what `wpt-dataset build` builds; recipes with the same data share one dataset

mixture.description: a file name in data/recipes/mixtures/, without .json

tokenizer.description: a file name in data/recipes/tokenizers/, without .json

held_out.description: share of every source's documents kept out of training

model.description: the architecture's numbers (docs/model.md; wpt_model.ModelConfig without vocab_size, which the tokenizer gives, and block_size, the last stage's window)

n_layer.description: a global layer (CSA or HCA) every 4th layer and the last, KDA elsewhere

global_attention.description: the kind of each global layer, in order: one per 4th layer and the last

kda_head_dim.description: keys and values of a KDA head

attention_heads.description: query heads of CSA, HCA and the multi-token prediction block

attention_head_dim.description: each query head and the one key-value head: the 64 rotary dimensions and FP8 blocks of 64

query_rank.description: width of the query latent, shared with the indexer

output_groups.description: groups of the grouped output projection; divides attention_heads

output_rank.description: width of each group's intermediate output

index_heads.description: query heads of the CSA indexer

index_head_dim.description: each indexer head and key: a power of 2 (the Hadamard rotation), more than the 64 rotary dimensions

index_top_k.description: merged entries each query attends to in a CSA layer

top_k.description: routed experts per token, fewer than n_experts

expert_width.description: hidden width of a routed expert

latent_width.description: width of the space routed experts work in

shared_width.description: hidden width of each of the 2 shared experts

engram_layers.description: layers (numbered from 1) that get Engram memory

engram_order.description: largest N-gram; orders 2 .. N are read

engram_table_size.description: each table has a distinct prime size, the smallest at or above this

method.description: a built-in method of wpt_training, or a .py file

settings.description: the method's settings; those left out keep the method's defaults

stages.description: trained in order, each on windows of its length (docs/training.md, "Stages"); the model's context is the last one's

block_size.description: tokens per training window in this stage

steps.description: maximum number of updates in this stage

batch_size.description: windows per update in this stage, over every process together

eval_batches.description: global batches of the stage averaged per evaluation

drafter.description: the drafter wpt-train trains at the end of the run, and wpt-posttrain at the end of every run (docs/model.md, "The drafter"; wpt_inference.drafting); a setting left out keeps its default

features.description: the model layers whose hidden states the drafter reads, numbered from 1 to the model's n_layer (a run refuses another before it trains); default: wpt_model.drafter.feature_layers

markov_rank.description: rank of the Markov head; default 256 x d_model / 4096

warm_up.description: share of the updates the learning rate rises over

anchors.description: anchors drawn from each answer per epoch

prompts.description: training documents whose beginnings are prompts

prompt_tokens.description: the most tokens of a document's beginning in its prompt

answer_tokens.description: the most tokens of each answer the model writes

held_out.description: share of the prompts kept apart for calibration and the measure

posttrain.description: the steps `wpt-posttrain` runs, in order: built-in step names or .py files
